# Autowrap (DECAWM is on by default) and the pending-wrap state, plus REP.

=== Filling the last column leaves a pending wrap
source: vttest menu 1 (autowrap); xterm ctlseqs DECAWM
input: 0123456789
cursor: 1,10 wrap

=== The next character wraps to the next line
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_DECAWM
input: 0123456789ab
cursor: 2,3
screen:
|0123456789|
|ab........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== CR in the pending wrap returns to column one
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_DECAWM_CursorAtRightMargin
input: 0123456789\rX
cursor: 1,2
screen:
|X123456789|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== A wrap at the bottom scrolls into the scrollback
source: vttest menu 1 (autowrap at the last line)
size: 4x2
scrollback: 10
input: abcdefghij
cursor: 2,3
history: 1
screen:
|efgh|
|ij..|

=== Backspace in the pending wrap moves off the last column
source: esctest2 bs.py test_BS_CursorStartsInDoWrapPosition
input: 0123456789\bX
cursor: 1,10
screen:
|01234567X9|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== REP repeats the last printed character
source: esctest2 rep.py test_REP_ExplicitParam
input: a\e[3b
cursor: 1,5
screen:
|aaaa......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== REP defaults to one and wraps like printing
source: esctest2 rep.py test_REP_DefaultParam
input: \e[1;9Hx\e[b\e[b
cursor: 2,2
screen:
|........xx|
|x.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== REP with nothing printed does nothing
source: xterm ctlseqs REP (repeats the preceding graphic character)
input: \e[5b
cursor: 1,1
